comingLast.roast: finished on 20 - the bravest thing now is staying for the presentation
3 holes of runway left - 1 point clears the fence
the gap to Carroll is 1 - his short game is now a public interest matter
his round is over, his sweating is not - 2 above the line
done and dangling 3 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
in on a cushion of 3 - refreshing the board between sips
one quiet stretch from joining Carroll in the conversation nobody wants
3 points from the wooden end of the presentation
in the clubhouse, 4 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
done, 5 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
